tools.name: search
tools.description: Find 1C test-client actions for execute. Empty query: groups and action names. An action name: its parameters (* required) and documentation. Words: matching actions, documentation of the first 8.

tools.name: execute
tools.description:
Run 1C test-client actions in order: calls=[{action, args, connection_id}], 1-20 calls. The batch stops at the first step with ok=false or an error; the answer is {ok, stopped_at, steps}. Parameters and documentation of an action: search(query="<action>"); wrong names or types are refused before anything is sent, with the signature; all calls are checked before the first runs. Known synonyms (area/address/start_address/cell/range, ref for root_ref) are accepted and reported as renamed. Without a connection a step answers not_connected with suggested_call.
A string argument "$N.path" takes a value from the response of step N of this batch (keys and list indexes by dots: "$0.object.ref"); start a literal "$" with "$$".
Use returned ref/root_ref values unchanged; re-find expired elements. A ref selects its client; otherwise set connection_id when several clients are connected (list_connections).
ok=true means accepted; verify effects by reading state. target_check: present, unknown (uncheckable), off (disabled); present does not prove an effect. target_hidden=true means the target exists but is invisible; it describes the element, not its ancestors. Its absence says nothing; hidden targets may still act (e.g. activate). Invalid addresses are rejected only where the address can be checked; an unverified empty read may mean a missing target. failure_context describes state/editor/choices; its complete=false means incomplete diagnostics.
Success may omit target/connection echoes and shorten window details.
Screenshots come as images; the step of an image has image=<number>.

args.description: Parameters of the action (search shows them).

note: действие без подключения, клиентов в реестре нет
